speaker_role: independent counselor (Yale grad, co-founder of ElevatEd School)
commercial_incentive: actively markets ElevatEd School's paid coaching for essays, interviews, resumes, and transfer applications
key_insights: Says the 'intend to continue in college' checkbox should be answered consistently with any career/major interest stated in the essays, since inconsistency can look like a red flag.
Advises using every available character: list multiple leadership titles/positions held over time in the 50-character field rather than one generic word like 'president.'
Recommends hyper-specific job titles (e.g., 'social media marketing intern, SEO optimization' instead of just 'intern') to leave more room for describing accomplishments.
Suggests adding brief descriptive context to organization names (e.g., naming a club's size or founding status) rather than just its bare title.
Advises always spelling out acronyms and honors names, since US admissions readers, and especially international-applicant reviewers, may not recognize them.
Recommends ranking activities primarily by total time invested (hours/week x weeks/year x years) and secondarily by breadth of impact on others.
In the 150-character description, recommends leading with strong, specific verbs and concrete numbers rather than vague duty lists.
Suggests it's acceptable to add personality/humor to descriptions, especially for lower-ranked activities (roughly ranks 7-10), but to get outside feedback before submitting.
Notes many students overlook the Common App's 'additional information' section as a place to list extra honors/awards tied to a top activity instead of cramming them into the activity description.
Warns strongly against exaggerating hours per week/weeks per year, since inconsistent totals are noticeable to readers and can damage credibility.
specific_numbers_or_facts: States the Common App activities section allows up to 10 entries.
States each activity entry has a 50-character position/leadership description field and a 150-character activity description field.
States organization name field has a 100-character limit.
notable_or_distinctive: Gives an unusually concrete, field-by-field breakdown of the Common App activities section's exact character limits and shows specific before/after phrasing examples for each tip.
reliability_notes: Clear, coherent transcript with no notable garbling; advice is presented as the counselor's own professional opinion and includes a self-promotional plug for his paid consulting service, so some framing (e.g., what 'ivy league admissions officers' supposedly want) is unverifiable.
